test_title: PYST 10:SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On:18 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, Il and lII. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All fruits are wines.

Some wines are juices.

All juices are alcohols.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some alcohols are juices.

Il. Some wines are alcohols.

III. Some wines are fruits.

options.text: Only conclusions I and Il follow
Only conclusions I and Ill follow
Only conclusions Il and Ill follow

solution:
Statements:

All fruits are wines.

Some wines are juices.

All juices are alcohols.
